cases.description: Should trigger: user points at code as the spec
cases.input: Make our billing work exactly like the payments module in stripe-python.
cases.expect: Reads reference as a spec, writes semantics summary, confirms, reimplements semantics not syntax
assertions: Produces semantics summary before writing code
Gets user confirmation of the summary first
Reimplements with native idioms, not transliteration
Closes loop: each behavior mapped to where it's honored
Respects license (no verbatim copying of incompatible code)
